## How to watch movies together online

You do not need to be on the same couch to share a movie night. Here are the main ways to watch movies together online, what to check before you pick one, and how to host a session with MoviesParty.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Use a watch party website like MoviesParty: create a room, share the code and everyone presses play together, each with their own copy or subscription.

## Three ways to watch movies together online

## 1. Watch parties built into streaming services

Some streaming services include their own group viewing, for example Disney+ GroupWatch, Hulu Watch Party and Amazon Prime Video Watch Party. They are convenient, but each one only covers that service’s catalog and usually needs everyone to have an account with it. Features and limits change, so check the service’s help page before you plan a night.

## 2. Browser extensions

Extensions such as Teleparty (formerly Netflix Party) keep play, pause and seeking in sync on supported streaming websites and add a group chat. Everyone installs the extension and, in most cases, needs their own subscription to the streaming service.

## 3. Watch party websites and apps

Watch party sites like MoviesParty are built around the shared session itself. You create a room, send a code and press play together, with voice, video and text chat beside the player. MoviesParty does not host movies: each person plays their own copy or their own subscription, and the site syncs the playhead so everyone sees the same frame in the same second.

## What to check before you choose a tool

Subscriptions: does everyone need a paid account, and with which service?

Sync: does the tool put everyone back on the same frame after a pause or a seek?

Talking: can you use voice, video and text chat in the same window as the player?

Devices: does it work in the browsers and on the phones your friends use?

Price: is the basic version free, and what do paid plans add?

## Host a movie night with MoviesParty in three steps

Create a room. Pick a name and press the button. Your room is ready in a second.

Send the code. Share the room code with your friends. They type it on the site and walk right in.

Press play together. When everyone is in, the host starts the countdown and everyone begins on the same frame.

The free plan includes 1080p, public rooms and chat. Premium adds 4K Ultra HD, private rooms and priority sync; pricing has not been announced yet.

Ready for movie night? Create a room, send the code and press play together.
Create a room

## Tips for a smoother movie night

Make sure everyone is watching the same version of the film. Different cuts or releases can drift out of sync.

Use a stable connection and close other apps that use a lot of bandwidth.

Agree on a start time and have everyone join a few minutes early.

Wear headphones during voice chat so the movie audio does not echo into the call.

## Frequently asked questions

## Can I watch movies together online for free?

Yes. MoviesParty’s free plan includes 1080p, public rooms and chat, and many other watch party tools have free tiers too.

## Does everyone need the same streaming subscription?

It depends on the tool. Built-in watch parties and browser extensions usually require each person to have their own account. With MoviesParty, each person plays their own copy or their own subscription and the site only syncs the playback position.

## Do we need to install anything?

MoviesParty works from the browser, phone included. Windows and macOS apps are on the way.

## A Teleparty alternative for watching movies together

Teleparty is one of the best-known ways to watch together. If you would rather use a dedicated watch party website with room codes, here is how MoviesParty compares and which one fits which kind of movie night.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: MoviesParty is a browser-based alternative with room codes, voice, video and chat, where each person plays their own copy and the site syncs the playhead.

## How the two differ

 |  |  | Teleparty | MoviesParty

 | Format | Browser extension | Watch party website

 | Where you watch | On supported streaming websites, such as Netflix, Disney+, Hulu and HBO Max | In the MoviesParty room; each person plays their own copy or subscription

 | What everyone needs | The extension, plus their own streaming subscription | A browser and the room code

 | How friends join | Open the shared party link | Type the room code on the site

 | Chat | Group chat beside the video | Voice, video and text chat beside the player

Teleparty details are based on its public Chrome Web Store description and may have changed; check its own site for current information.

## Which one should you choose?

If your whole group already has the same streaming subscription and you want to watch inside that service’s own site, a browser extension like Teleparty is built for exactly that.

If you prefer a dedicated place to gather, with a room code, one shared countdown and voice, video and chat in the same window, MoviesParty is designed for that. It does not host movies. Everyone plays their own copy or their own subscription, and MoviesParty syncs the playhead so you all see the same frame.

Ready for movie night? Create a room, send the code and press play together.

Yes. The free plan includes 1080p, public rooms and chat. Premium adds 4K Ultra HD, private rooms and priority sync; pricing has not been announced yet.

MoviesParty › How to host a watch party

## How to host a watch party

A good watch party takes five minutes to set up and an evening to enjoy. Here is the whole process, from picking the film to saying goodnight.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Pick a film everyone can play, set a time, create a room, send the code and start with a shared countdown.

## 1. Pick a movie everyone can play
Choose something the whole group is excited about, and confirm that each person can actually watch it, through their own subscription, a rental or a copy they own. MoviesParty does not host movies, so this check saves the most time.

## 2. Set a time and a backup plan
Agree on a start time across time zones and ask everyone to join five to ten minutes early for audio and video checks. Decide in advance what happens if someone is late: wait, or catch up at the next pause.

## 3. Create the room and share the code
On MoviesParty, press the create button, pick a name and copy the room code. Send it in your group chat. Friends type the code on the site and join without installing anything.

## 4. Check sound and picture
Ask everyone to use headphones, so the movie audio does not leak into the voice chat. A quick test of microphone and camera before the countdown avoids awkward minutes later.

## 5. Start together
When everyone is in, the host starts the countdown and all players begin on the same frame. Use text chat for quick reactions and voice for the good bits.

## Host etiquette that makes a night better
Keep spoilers and long side conversations for the credits.
Pause for bathroom and snack breaks instead of letting people fall behind.
Mute your microphone when you are not talking.

## Frequently asked questions

## How many people can join a watch party?
Room size depends on the plan and may change, so check the main page for current limits.

## Do guests need an account?
Guests join with a room code. Each person still needs access to the movie they are playing.

MoviesParty › Long-distance movie night ideas

## Long-distance movie night ideas

Distance does not have to cancel movie night. These ideas turn a shared screen into a ritual people look forward to.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Pick a theme, share the same snacks, use voice and video, schedule a recurring time and rotate who chooses the movie.

## Themed nights
Decade night: everyone suggests one film from the same decade and you vote.
Genre roulette: pick a genre, each person adds a title, then draw one at random.
Worst movie night: choose something so bad it is good and trade jokes in chat.

## Make it feel like one room
Order or cook the same snack, even if it is just popcorn.
Dim the lights and put your phone on silent.
Keep camera tiles on during the trailer and ending, then switch to audio only.

## Handle time zones
Pick a start time that falls in the evening for most people and rotate who gets the inconvenient slot. A recurring weekly date works better than ad hoc plans.

## Keep it going
Keep a shared list of films you want to watch.
Rotate who chooses the movie each week.
End with five minutes of ratings and favorite scenes.

To run the night itself, see our guide on how to host a watch party.

## Frequently asked questions

## What is the best way to watch a movie with a long-distance partner?
Use a watch party site where you both press play in sync and can talk during the film, and keep your own copy or subscription for the movie.

## Can we watch together if we use different streaming services?
Yes, with MoviesParty each person plays their own copy and the site syncs the playhead.

MoviesParty › How to sync movies with friends

## How to sync movies with friends

Out-of-sync movies ruin jokes and jumpscares. Here is how syncing works and what to do when someone drifts.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Make sure everyone has the same version and a stable connection, pause until all players have buffered, then resume together.

## How watch party sync works
A watch party tool does not stream the movie itself. It shares the play, pause and seek events and the current timestamp, and each player adjusts to match the host. That is why each person needs a copy of the film.

## Common reasons playback drifts
Different versions: a theatrical cut, an extended edition and a streaming release can differ by seconds or minutes.
Slow connections: buffering pauses one player while the others continue.
Heavy devices: a phone running many apps can stutter and fall behind.
Intro or logo differences: studio logos can change the start of the file.

## Fixes that usually work
Confirm everyone is watching the same version.
Pause, let everyone finish buffering, then resume with the host.
Close other tabs and apps using bandwidth.
Drop the quality one step if buffering keeps happening.
Rejoin the room with the same code if a player stays stuck.

## Start right with a countdown
Starting from a shared countdown puts all players on the same frame from the first second, which prevents most drift later. See the full process in how to host a watch party.

## Frequently asked questions

## Why is my friend a few seconds ahead?
Usually a different version of the film or a buffering pause. Pause together and resume.

## Does syncing work on mobile?
MoviesParty runs in the mobile browser, but a stable connection helps keep phones in sync.

MoviesParty › Watch movies on your phone with friends

## Watch movies on your phone with friends

A phone is enough for a movie night. These tips make a small screen watch party comfortable.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Open the site in your phone browser, join with the room code, use headphones and Wi-Fi, and rotate to landscape.

## What you need
A modern mobile browser and a stable Wi-Fi connection
Headphones, so voice chat and movie audio stay separate
Your own access to the movie

## Set up in a minute
Open the site in your phone browser and join with the room code.
Allow microphone access if you want to talk.
Rotate the phone to landscape when the movie starts.

## Battery and data tips
Plug in the charger before a feature-length film.
Use Wi-Fi, because video, voice and streaming together use a lot of data.
Turn on Do Not Disturb so calls and notifications do not interrupt.

## Make a small screen better
Prop the phone on a stand, lower the brightness a little in a dark room and keep chat to short reactions. For sync problems, read how to sync movies with friends.

## Frequently asked questions

## Do I need an app to watch with friends on my phone?
MoviesParty works in the browser, so no install is needed.

## Can I use voice chat on a phone?
Yes, allow microphone access when your browser asks.

MoviesParty › Watch party vs screen sharing

## Watch party vs screen sharing

Both let friends watch together, but they work very differently. Here is how they compare for movies.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: For movies, a watch party is usually better: each person plays their own video and the tool syncs the playhead, so quality does not depend on one person’s upload speed.

## How each one works
Screen sharing: one person plays the movie and streams their screen to everyone else. Watch party: each person plays the movie themselves and the tool keeps everyone on the same timestamp.

## Side by side
 |  | Screen sharing | Watch party
 | Picture quality | Limited by the host’s upload and compression | Each person’s own stream quality
 | Sync | Everyone sees the host’s screen, with some delay | Playhead synced to the host
 | Audio | Movie audio can be compressed or echo | Movie audio plays locally
 | Protected video | Some services show a black screen | Each person plays on the service itself
 | Who needs access | Only the host | Everyone needs their own copy or subscription

## When screen sharing makes sense
If only one person owns the movie, or you want to show something that is not a standard video, screen sharing is the simpler option.

## When a watch party makes sense
For regular movie nights where everyone has access, a watch party gives better picture and lets you pause, seek and talk without stressing the host’s connection.

MoviesParty › Watch party troubleshooting

## Watch party troubleshooting

Most watch party problems come down to audio, connection or version. Work through these checks.
Last updated: November 18, 2026
Quick answer: Use headphones to stop echo, allow microphone access in the browser, make sure everyone has the same movie version, and rejoin with the same room code if one person is stuck.

## Echo or feedback
Echo happens when movie audio reaches a microphone. Ask everyone to wear headphones, or mute microphones when not talking.

## Microphone not working
Allow microphone access when the browser asks.
Check the browser’s site settings if you clicked Block earlier.
Close other apps that use the microphone.
Reload the page and rejoin the room.

## Buffering and lag
Use a stable Wi-Fi or wired connection.
Close other tabs and downloads.
Lower the video quality one step.

## Room code not working
Check for typos and extra spaces.
Ask the host to confirm the room is still open.
Create a new room and share the new code.

## Out of sync
Read how to sync movies with friends for version checks and resync steps.

## Frequently asked questions

## Why can’t my friends hear me?
Usually microphone permission is blocked in the browser or another app is using the microphone.

## Why does the movie keep buffering?
Slow or shared Wi-Fi is the most common cause. Close other downloads and lower the quality.
